## User-visible changes

- Nothing is installed into the kernel; the first Run all builds an isolated environment (about 8 GB). The learner cells are short `run_stage(...)` calls; the workflow code is in the carried stage runner.
- New fields: `BYOD_PATH`, `INFERENCE_CELLS` (Section 4), `RUN_ACTIVITY`, `ACTIVITY_TRAINABLE_LAYERS` (Section 13). New Section 13 (optional activity).
- The held-out evaluation and the new-cell inference are computed by the exported adapter rebuilt in fresh processes; reload parity compares that with the adapting process.
- Outputs: `outputs/scgpt_single_cell_dataset.csv` (was `…_sample_dataset.csv`), new `outputs/scgpt_single_cell_input_manifest.json`; the evaluation report adds `interpretation`, `computed_by` and the difference from the adapting process.
- BYOD files too small for a valid training split now stop in Section 4 with the true minimum.

## Verification

All offline; none of it is clean-runtime or pretrained-model evidence.

- CI command set in a Python 3.12 venv with only `pytest`, `ruff` and the package installed `--no-deps` (as CI does): `ruff check src tests tools` clean; pytest 51 → 70 passed; `tools/validate_release_assets.py` and `tools/build_notebook.py --check` pass.
- **Offline probe** (the notebook's own cells exec'd in order; the install cell's venv replaced by a local CPython 3.12 interpreter; the real package with the committed vocabulary, config and README; `model.safetensors` a dummy and the encoder replaced by a deterministic numpy stand-in — embedding, decoder, `adapt`, `save_artifact` and `from_artifact` — because the locked torch needs several GB of CUDA libraries this container cannot hold and the Hub is unreachable): every default stage completes; the real data path reproduces the review's numbers (64 cells, library sizes 19,986–20,012, digest `ce627233…`, splits 36 / 12 / 16, library-size baseline 0.625 / 0.619 / AUROC 0.7188); reload parity across processes `PASS` (max diff 0.0); re-running Section 1 then Section 11 works; the activity writes only to `outputs/activity/`. BYOD: a 40-cell CSV by path outside Colab completes with 6 held-back cells; 16 cells hold back 2 and say so; 10 cells are refused in Section 4 with "supply at least 7 cells per class"; `.txt`, a ragged row, an empty path outside Colab, a cancelled upload and a two-file upload stop with named messages; an upload in Colab completes Section 4.

## Remaining gates

1. A hosted one-pass **Run all** of the regenerated blob with defaults, recorded with `restarted: false`, versions, the encoder's metrics and the reload parity (this also confirms the real encoder path, which the probe replaced).
2. The REL12 BYOD journey: a path-based compatible and incompatible file on Kaggle or Jupyter, and the upload dialog on Colab.
3. Maintainer: decide whether to replace the saturated default task (SCG-S1); update the release records for the new blob.
